title: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing validation vulnerability in a Stock…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a vulnerability in the Stock module where the system fails to validate that reserved item rows belong to the target Sales Order. This allows authenticated users with the Stock User role to reserve stock items against other orders, causing mismatched Stock Reservation Entries.
